definitions: To leave a place, often suddenly or for a specific purpose.
To start ringing or making a loud noise (e.g., an alarm).
To become bad or spoiled (food or drink).
To happen or proceed in a particular way.
examples: She went off to college last year.
My alarm clock didn't go off this morning.
The milk will go off if you leave it out.
The party went off without a hitch.
The lights went off during the storm.
